mapper.select: SELECT 'THEME' AS tag_type, td.theme_code AS tag_code, td.theme_name AS tag_name, tt.term_text AS term_text, tt.normalized_term AS normalized_term, ttr.relation_type AS relation_type, ttr.weight AS weight, td.version AS dictionary_version FROM theme_dictionary td JOIN theme_term_relation ttr ON ttr.theme_code = td.theme_code AND ttr.version = td.version JOIN theme_term tt ON tt.id = ttr.term_id AND tt.version = td.version WHERE td.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ttr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND tt.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'INDUSTRY' AS tag_type, industry_code AS tag_code, industry_name AS tag_name, industry_name AS term_text, LOWER(REPLACE(industry_name, ' ', '')) AS normalized_term, 'REQUIRED' AS relation_type, 1.0000 AS weight, version AS dictionary_version FROM industry_dictionary WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'INDUSTRY' AS tag_type, industry_code AS tag_code, industry_name AS tag_name, aliases AS term_text, LOWER(REPLACE(aliases, ' ', '')) AS normalized_term, 'ALIAS' AS relation_type, 0.8000 AS weight, version AS dictionary_version FROM industry_dictionary WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND aliases IS NOT NULL AND aliases != '' UNION ALL SELECT 'COMPANY' AS tag_type, sd.ticker AS tag_code, sd.company_name AS tag_name, sa.alias_text AS term_text, sa.normalized_alias AS normalized_term, 'ALIAS' AS relation_type, 1.0000 AS weight, sd.version AS dictionary_version FROM security_dictionary sd JOIN security_alias sa ON sa.security_code = sd.security_code AND sa.version = sd.version WHERE sd.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT 'TICKER' AS tag_type, ticker AS tag_code, company_name AS tag_name, ticker AS term_text, LOWER(REPLACE(ticker, ' ', '')) AS normalized_term, 'REQUIRED' AS relation_type, 1.0000 AS weight, version AS dictionary_version FROM security_dictionary WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 'v1') FROM theme_dictionary WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
